notes: «قَالَ أَبِي رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ فِي رِسَالَتِهِ إِلَيَّ» gives the father as the writer of a letter quoted by the compiler: the author of a cited work, rule 11, so the ruling is for the archive
